newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: Botswana's Bushmen leader dies after long illness.
newsitem.headline: Botswana's Bushmen leader dies after long illness.

text.p: The leader of Botswana's Bushmen community, John Hardbattle, has died after a long fight against cancer. He was 51.
Hardbattle led "The First People of the Kalahari", an organisation he set up to fight the Botswana government for Bushmen's rights.
He will be buried on Saturday and is survived by his wife and two children, the weekly newspaper MMEGI reported on Friday.

Hardbattle became an international figure over the fight by Bushmen living in the Central Kalahari Game Reserve to stop alleged moves by the Botswana government to resettle them and make way for tourist development of the reserve.
